sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: release-tracks: the third-party "MB: Inline per-recording streaming & download links" userscript's own `<dl class="ar">` container isn't always a sibling of MusicBrainz's native `<div class="ars">` relationship block — when nested inside it instead, the emptied shell (its own "▼ Streaming/Downloads:" toggle button and label) was left stranded inside the "ARs" column's cell after its actual link data was correctly extracted into the dedicated "Streaming/Downloads" column. Now detached from the DOM the moment it's found, regardless of its original nesting depth, so it's discarded cleanly either way.
